description: Creates a client site: the home for one client website's showcases, videos, collections, and feedback. Use it when the client has no site yet; check list_sites first to avoid duplicates. Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation. Counts toward the plan's site allowance; safe to retry, since the same name and domain return the same site.

domain.description: The website's hostname, e.g. "acme.com" (a pasted URL like https://www.acme.com/ also works).

name.description: Client or website name, e.g. "Acme Builders".

name: create_site
title: Create client site
